notes: Semgrep p/smart-contracts returned 48 findings, ALL severity INFO (use-custom-error-not-require, use-prefix-increment, use-nested-if, short-revert-string, ownable2step, non-payable-constructor, array-length-outside-loop, unnecessary-checked-arithmetic) -> discarded as gas/style per normalization rule.
Aderyn 'Unchecked Return' (6) and 'Uninitialized Local Variable' (1) corroborate Slither at identical lines and are merged into the corresponding Slither findings (corroboratingSources=[aderyn]).
Aderyn HIGH 'Reentrancy: State change after external call' (line 392) corroborates the Slither initiateMigration reentrancy-no-eth finding.

All reentrancy findings sit on nonReentrant-guarded functions calling protocol-trusted contracts (phUSD minter / owner-set IYieldStrategy); not attacker-controlled. Likely not exploitable - flagged for classifier.
Aderyn 'Centralization Risk' dropped: owner is trusted by design (Law 3 / documented known issue).
